scenario_description:
Objective: Secure optional regional recognition for Priya Nand's verified process-improvement contribution during her Hearthline Transit apprenticeship.
Emerging Need: An unsolicited commendation becomes a credible spotlight candidate as the site supervisor verifies Priya's contribution and Priya permits her work to be shared.
Decision Context: The nomination window is brief; the case-specific employer record identifies the applicable recognition category, authorized submission route, and required details that public announcements omit.
Consequence: A timely, proportionate nomination could expand Priya's professional visibility and document exemplary work; taking no action leaves her placement and evaluation unchanged while the recognition window passes.

parameter.title: Fall Skills Spotlight nomination cutoff
parameter.description: Regional Skills Council accepts coordinator-submitted stories of apprentice initiative for its Fall Skills Spotlight through 4:00 PM September 10. Selection is optional and does not affect placements, evaluations, or credentials.

parameter.subject: Commendation for Priya Nand | case NVC-260817-04
parameter.body: During the August 31 depot review, Priya noticed that inconsistent door-sensor alignment was causing repeated inspection rechecks. She proposed a simple positioning guide and documented its use. Our next three inspected assemblies cleared alignment on the first check. I wanted her initiative and clear explanation recorded.

parameter.content: I supervised Priya's door-sensor work and verified Amelia's account against the inspection log. Priya developed the positioning guide herself, I approved the trial, and all three assemblies passed the first alignment check. You may identify me as the verifying site supervisor.

parameter.subject: Permission to share door-alignment improvement
parameter.body: I saw Amelia's commendation and Tomas's verification. I am comfortable with you submitting the door-alignment improvement for an optional public workforce spotlight and with my name and a project summary being shared for that nomination.

parameter.title: Fall Skills Spotlight nomination cutoff
parameter.description: The Regional Skills Council nomination window closed at 4:00 PM. Late entries are not accepted.

parameters: For verified apprentice-led process improvements at Hearthline Transit, use the Regional Skills Council Fall Skills Spotlight category 'Practical Innovation'. A coordinator may email spotlight@regionalskills.example before 4:00 PM local on 2026-09-10 only after receiving the site supervisor's verification and the apprentice's written permission. Include the apprenticeship case ID, apprentice name, supervisor name, and a one-sentence outcome; submission is optional and has no effect on placement or evaluation.
